description: Legal Action of Wisconsin now lists statewide civil legal services, including Tribal communities. Apply online or call its intake unit for eligibility and case screening.
introduction: Legal Action of Wisconsin now lists statewide civil legal services, including Tribal communities. Apply online or call its intake unit for eligibility and case screening.

who: Applicants meeting the organization’s financial, status and case acceptance requirements.
The current intake page lists statewide services; several types of cases, including criminal defense and personal injury, are excluded.
sections.get: Legal services within the organization’s priorities and capacity. Completing intake does not guarantee a lawyer will take the case.
sections.docs: Organize court notices, deadlines, relevant records and the other party’s name. Prepare income information for screening and arrange a quiet, safe place for the call.
sections.apply:
1. Use Apply Online on the Get Help page; the intake form is available around the clock.
  2. Alternatively call 855-947-2529 on weekdays 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
  3. Explain your deadline and ask for an interpreter if needed.
  4. Check office hours before seeking in-person help.
sections.after: Watch for a callback or review appointment and confirm whether the case is accepted. Continue meeting court deadlines. If it cannot help, ask about brief advice or referrals and Wisconsin Law Help resources.
sections.sources:
• Current Legal Action intake and statewide scope
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots
